context: Ren and Hina-young go to a butterfly garden together.
purpose: Adult mentor and teen sharing nature appreciation.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Ren, look — there are so many butterflies!
lines.style: Breathless wonder. Quick bright attack on the opening. Awed tone, eyes wide. Pace races ahead of her breath. Radiates the pure delight of an 8-year-old sharing discovery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: The colors are really beautiful, aren't they?
lines.style: Quiet, genuinely moved. Soft warm start. Each word weighted with real attention. Not performing awe — actually seeing. Slight pause as if the beauty is settling in him.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: They're flying from flower to flower.
lines.style: Gentle observation, almost whispered. Soft underlying smile in the voice. Pace slows — watching with her. The tone of someone noticing the small miracle happening in front of them.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 自然の美しさ、感じます。
lines.en: You can feel it — the beauty of nature.
lines.style: Tender, almost reverent. Slow opening. Quiet conviction. Breathes space into the moment. Not explaining, inviting her to feel it too. Trailing softness at the end.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Yeah, I want to take a picture!
lines.style: Bright eager burst. Quick attack on the opening word. Warm excited energy. The urgency of wanting to hold onto the moment. Still childlike wonder — no irony.
